objective_contribution: Generalize ARE review into one mandatory completion-or-capacity decision boundary while counting all model tokens and adding no retries.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does a completion-or-capacity boundary guarantee a bounded one-call slate review and replicate the fresh GLM 8K quality gain while retaining every failed token receipt?

experiment_and_task_refs.unresolved: Three-boundary tests, fresh selection, repositories, preflight, freeze, live run, score, and decision.

measurement_mapping.native: Paired control and slate outputs scored on all eight fixed identities.
measurement_mapping.retention: Pressure arms share one receipt-bound common evidence envelope; only treatment receives the slate.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Branches share exact ancestry; failed output receipts remain in both arms; no replacement request precedes the fork.
measurement_mapping.tokens: All failed and successful input plus output tokens count. Each branch has one call and paired difference is at most 3,072.
measurement_mapping.transfer: Development canary cannot establish larger-window, cross-model, non-code, repair, or benchmark-wide transfer.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: GLM small-window chapter before larger windows
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: New identities absent from recorded matrices and selected before gold access.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: One frozen prefix and review per arm and identity; no reruns or replacements.

retained_counterevidence: Round 35 stopped after four pairs on glm.incomplete-output.

The output-pressure review transition is implemented locally but untested live.
successor_rule: Pass advances to a larger fresh development replication; failure reviews H58, H0, and the complete capacity-boundary evidence.

criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: Round 35 observations lead to H60, H58, and H0.
